OPENCLASH_API_URL.description: LAN or loopback URL of the managed OpenClash/Mihomo controller API

OPENCLASH_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE.description: macOS Keychain service containing the OpenClash API secret

OPENCLASH_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT.description: macOS Keychain account containing the OpenClash API secret

OPENCLASH_SSH_HOST.description: Trusted-LAN hostname or address of the managed OpenClash router

OPENCLASH_SSH_USER.description: SSH account used for explicitly authorized router configuration

OPENCLASH_SSH_KEY_PATH.description: Machine-local path to the dedicated OpenClash SSH private key

FRESHRSS_BASE_URL.description: Loopback FreshRSS base URL used by rss-ops

FRESHRSS_DATA_DIR.description: FreshRSS host data directory containing config.php and users/

FRESHRSS_USER.description: FreshRSS local username managed by rss-ops

RSS_AI_DB_PATH.description: Sage Agent Host RSS AI SQLite database

RSS_OPS_STATE_DIR.description: Machine-local mutable state directory for rss-ops
